critical_comparability_facts: The 2026 host-free study contains no host-present randomized arm.
The within-study no-myristic-acid versus 0.5 mM myristic-acid contrast changes exogenous carbon in a host-free system; it is not a host-presence experiment.
Bulk cytoplasmic particle trajectories and Nile-red fluorescent-lipid cargo speeds are distinct outcomes.
The 2025 and 2026 studies differ in plate geometry and time origin; the 2026 authors explicitly caution that absolute growth comparisons are not direct.
The 2026 paper reports raw data available upon request; no raw-data reproduction is claimed.
Even if study context descriptors appear similar, distinct study IDs remain separate and are not pooled by this software gate.

implementation_contract.pooling_policy: cross-study context results never authorize automatic pooling or causal effect estimation
